However, I think you would have to compare that to investing 130k in the market, and just driving for Uber/lyft/doordash, etc. so the question is if the additional income is worth that 130k cost. At a 4400 monthly income, personally, it doesn’t sound worth while to me. edit: i did NOT realize that buying a medallion meant that you would rent it out and have someone else drive the cab.
